/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, math, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
src = pathlib.Path('core.cpp').resolve()
ch,n,taps,seed = 3,1024,31,9
h=[]; hs=0.0
for k in range(taps):
    z=(k-(taps-1)*0.5)/(taps*0.5)
    v=(0.5+0.5*math.cos(math.pi*z))*math.cos(.23*k)
    h.append(v); hs += abs(v)
h=[v/hs for v in h]
bins=[[0.0,0.0] for _ in range(16)]
samples=[]
ids=[0,n//11,n//3,n//2,n-1,(ch-1)*n+n//4]
for c in range(ch):
    for i in range(n):
        acc=0.0
        for k in range(taps):
            q=i+k-taps//2
            if 0 <= q < n:
                acc += (math.sin((q+seed*7+c*13)*.017)+.35*math.cos((q*3+seed+c*5)*.009))*h[k]
        idx=c*n+i; bins[idx%16][0]+=acc; bins[idx%16][1]+=acc*acc
        if idx in ids: samples.append(acc)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    exe=pathlib.Path(d)/'probe'
    subprocess.run(['c++','-O2','-std=c++17','-DVALUE=double',str(src),'-o',str(exe)],check=True)
    out=json.loads(subprocess.run([str(exe),str(ch),str(n),str(taps),str(seed)],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout)
    e=max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(out['samples'],samples))
    ce=max(abs(out['checksums'][b][j]-bins[b][j])/((ch*n+15-b)//16) for b in range(16) for j in range(2))
    assert e <= 2e-9 and ce <= 2e-8, (e,ce)
    print(json.dumps({'diagnostic_double_probe':'PASS','max_sample_error':e,'max_checksum_error_per_element':ce,'storage_bytes_reported':out['storage_bytes']}))
PY"
